answer: Each agent identity enters the ledge state tree only after a TPM/SGX enclave emits a zero-knowledge attestation binding code, a silicon key, and bounded hardware-clock drift; the nectar consensus contract verifies proofs and commits roots to the ocean hash-anchor log. Forging identities requires physical enclave duplication or key compromise, while registration bonds follow an O(N^2) curve and failed proofs irreversibly slash collateral.
